title: Adapter Configuration Migration
definition: The process of migrating a machine learning model adapter from one version of a library to another, ensuring compatibility and preserving functionality.

difficulty_levels.beginner: When a machine learning model adapter is saved with one version of a library, and then we want to use it with a different version, we need to migrate the adapter's configuration to match the new library version.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Adapter configuration migration involves adapting a machine learning model's configuration to match a new version of a library, ensuring compatibility and functionality when loading the saved model.
difficulty_levels.expert: Adapter configuration migration is a process in machine learning that ensures compatibility between the saved configuration of a model's adapter and the new version of a library when loading the saved model, maintaining the original functionality.

extra_fields.insight: The necessity of adapting machine learning model adapters to new library versions for compatibility.
